items.text: EVERYONE!

The time has finally come. We’ve been hinting that we were working on something special, and today we are beyond thrilled to finally pull back the curtain and announce the next chapter in the universe: SPRAWL zero.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3748520/SPRAWL_zero/"]
(Please hit that Wishlist button, it is the single best way to support us as an indie team!)

If SPRAWL was our blood-soaked love letter to the '90s, SPRAWL Zero is our homage to the Golden Age of 2000s console shooters. SPRAWL Zero is heavily inspired by the dynamic worlds and tactical firefights of classics like F.E.A.R., Halo, and Half-Life 2.
Before SEVEN, there was FIVE…

In SPRAWL zero, you play as FIVE, a cybernetically enhanced supersoldier controlled by the Junta. Your directive is absolute: eliminate SILAS, the leader of the radical techno-religious group IMAGO-DEI. As the city plunges into chaos and factions both known and unknown grasp for the reins, you must reconcile your truths... or succumb to the SPRAWL.

Combat in SPRAWL zero is fast-paced but heavily grounded. We have built a smart, coordinated enemy AI system where squads will communicate, flank, lay down covering fire, and flush you out with grenades to wrestle the advantage away from you.
To survive the diverse roster of organic, mechanical, and airborne factions, FIVE must outsmart the opposition using an expanded suite of cybernetics:
Gravity Shield & Gloves: Expand combat beyond the gun. Catch enemy bullets and hurl them right back, or manipulate physics to control the battlefield.
Stylish Bullet-Time: Bend your shots midair with inhuman precision to ensure you never miss.
Rushdown: Barrel through enemy lines with moments of invulnerability and destructive force.
Massive Arsenal: Master over 40 distinct weapons, each with their own unique roles and mastery paths.

All of this takes place across masterfully crafted levels featuring deep verticality and alternate routes. Player agency is a fundamental pillar of our Y2K design philosophy, whether you push aggressively, play tactically from cover, or dominate encounters through physics-based combat, the game accommodates your playstyle.
Wrapped in an authentic, gritty Y2K cyberpunk aesthetic and backed by an industry-leading original soundtrack of intense early-2000s electronic music, SPRAWL zero is everything we love about the era.
SPRAWL zero is the game we always wanted to make, and we’re so excited to showcase everything about it over the coming months.

We’ve also just pushed an update to the base game today (v1.6). We’ve made some changes to how we build updates for the game, which should introduce massive stability improvements for everyone. Beyond that we’ve made changes to basically every level in the game that improve enemy pathfinding, improve wall-run reliability, and fix longstanding collision issues prevalent. There are also fixes for tons of bugs that have been present for some time now.
If you boot up SPRAWL, you’ll notice a shiny new button right on the main menu that links directly to the SPRAWL zero store page, making it easier than ever to check it out.
We still have plans to provide even more in the near future, so keep an eye out!

Thank you all for the incredible support over the years. We couldn't build these games without this amazing community. Go wishlist SPRAWL zero, jump into the Discord to tell us what you think of the trailer, and get ready for what's next.
Love you all!
Carlos (REVEL): Patch Notes

Engine Backend Upgraded: Updated to the latest engine build. This addresses legacy backend bugs and resolves some longstanding save data issues. This is a massive update that should improve stability for everyone!
Dynamic Menu UI: Main menu background screens are now tied to save data and will dynamically update to reflect your current campaign progress.
Codex Visuals: Overhauled the UI and visual presentation of the Codex system.
Codex Bug Fixes: Resolved an error where Codex data failed to populate upon item pickup.
Codex Bug Fixes: Corrected mislabeled lore entry in the database.
Navmesh Rebuild: Updated AI navigation meshes in key encounter areas to improve enemy tracking and movement.
Collision Passes: Fixed multiple instances of mismatched mesh collisions to prevent player snagging and invisible walls.
Episode 1: E1M1, E1M2, E1M3, E1M4, E1M5
Episode 2: E2M1, E2M2, E2M3, E2M4
Episode 3: E3M1, E3M2, E3M3
We’ve been listening and working diligently, and we’re super happy to announce that SPRAWL is now out on Playstation 5, and Xbox Series consoles! Check out the trailer below:

Not only that but we’ve just launched a massive QOL update that fixes numerous bugs, adds some requested community features as well as increasing the amount of languages SPRAWL supports to 10! This means that there’s never been a better time to give the game another go or to hop in for the first time. These include:
Button prompts now display on tutorials and switches across keyboard and controller.
Players now respawn with a minimum of 4 pistol shots to help get back on their feet without relying on melee.
Respawn now includes 4 seconds of invulnerability.
Fixed an issue with hitstun on various enemies.
Addressed enemy navigation issues across levels in the game.
Fixed music looping issues on all race maps.
Resolved an issue with Codex navigation.
Fixed issues with Codex labeling.
Various fixes to all localizations.
Improved setting sliders functionality for gamepad users.
Added additional languages with proper font fallbacks.
And many more!
And if you haven't yet, please give us some love and review the game!
We’ve got a lot more planned in the future, so stay tuned and join our discord for official updates or if you just want to chat with the developers, we’re always around to answer any questions!
Discord
P.S. Keep those clips coming on Discord and X/Twitter (@SprawlFPS), and throw in a tag for our publisher (@rogue_co) so they can join the fun too. Cheers! 🙌
Everyone!

We’ve been hard at work bringing some new content, plus some heavily requested features and bug fixes into the game. Game dev for a team of two is tough, but we love you all and wanted to continue to iterate on the game. We read every piece of feedback and although we can’t get everything in at once, we’ve got some cool things to give you this time around. As always, for free, no DLC here!

The QR code logs are now LIVE and in game. You will now be able to view them from inside SPRAWL and have them saved for you to revisit later. With the same not so subtle stylistic reference you get when you view them with your phone. This has been a colossal effort from Hannah to get all 50 lore docs into the game, so some kudos are in order!
Thank you all again for being a part of this incredible community, all the love, support and kindness keeps us going. We couldn’t have built SPRAWL without you all.
We’ve got some more things in store in the future, so keep an eye out for that!
Added “Codex” into the game. Walking over a PDA with a QR code on it will automatically populate the “Codex” menu. 50 pieces of unique collectable lore are now accessible in game.
Added Time Trial map “TIER 2 MOVEMENT (ADVANCED)”
Added Time Trial map “SLINGSHOT (ADVANCED)”
Added secondary weapons to all time trial maps with shotguns. This should allow for quick swapping movement tricks.
Added option to disable gamepad auto switching
Added option to hide crosshair
Fixed issue with lights not saving their state when hitting checkpoints
Fixed collision issues on E3M2
Updated navigation mesh on E1M2
Fixed issue where prototype enemy would be stuck behind shield wall on E3M2
Fixed issue with drops not triggering on prototype carrier enemy on E3M3
Fixed collision issue on some walls in E2M2
Fixed collision issue on some walls in E2M3

First of all, we have to say a huge thank you to everyone! It’s been an amazing first week seeing our game out in the wild and seeing people play it. Truly a dream come true for the two of us. We look forward to continuing to support the game.
We’ve seen the feedback and we’ve got you with our first set of fixes (yes including the fix to protect your eardrums!).

We hope to address all the comments and concerns, and we promise you are heard and appreciated! Please bear with us over the next few weeks as the two of us continue to work as hard as we can on a multitude of other changes and fixes. More options coming soon, and more content!
Fixed deafening sound on respawn!

Removed scanlines from codex QR codes to make them easier to scan. (try using the Google Lens app if you are still facing issues, we are planning to bring these lore entries in-game in order to make the scanning optional. All achievements are obtainable simply by walking up to the golden PDAs).
Tutorials have been re-written to be more descriptive.
Fixed the “REAPER” boss respawning after death.
Added input buffering to weapon firing.
Allow people to bind the mouse wheel back to next/previous weapon. (bindings to other actions will be fixed in future updates).
Fixed some instances of the game crashing on respawn screen.
Railgun charge speed increased by 25%.
Alleviated some issues with inconsistent AI pathing in the arena on E1M4.
Fixed clipping into the boat on E1M5.
Fixed issue where prototype enemy would be stuck behind shield wall on E3M1.
Fixed issue where chaingun enemy pickups would not grant player ammo.
Fixed issue with lift in E1M3 being able to leave without you if you clipped the trigger.
Attempted fix with second arena in E2M2 not spawning enemies.
Fixed players potentially being able to phase through a collider that pushes them on the waterfall section of E2M4.
Gave players some more platforms to use on bossfight in E2M4.
Increased ammo drops inside the boss arena in E2M4.
Added teleporter triggers to GOR Complex tower climb (E2M4)
Robot grunts have had their health cut from 300hp to 250hp.
Robot grunts now drop double the amount of handgun ammo.
Robot grunts' accuracy has been increased slightly.
Robot grunts now ragdoll correctly.
Berserkers have had their health reduced from 800hp to 700hp.
Berserkers will now drop chaingun ammo when killed.
Berserkers will now show damage to their body.
Fixed controller navigation getting stuck on the "Apply" button in display settings.
Fixed broken visuals on the melee weapon when weapon bobbing is set to 0.
Light Mech Class Spectre has had its health reduced from 600 to 350
Some platforming in E3M3 has been made easier with additional platforms to land on.
General changes to resource economy from weapon ammo drops on enemies has been rebalanced to make the later half of SPRAWL less reliant on weak point targeting.
Some additional geometry has been added in the final arena in E3M1 to allow the player to easily target heads.
Fixed issue where the player could die before the elevator finishes leaving in E3M1.
Fixed issue where the first arena in E2M1 would potentially soft lock.
Voiceline that was previously untied to the volume slider has been corrected in E2M4 Bossfight.
Hannah actually played the game this time.
NOTE: Other improvements around wall running are in progress! It will take some time as we need to be careful not to break existing levels or movement tech but we are hard at work.
Keep sending in your feedback and comments! You can also share captures with us in Discord and X/Twitter (@SprawlFPS and tag our publisher so they can share them too @rogue_co).
